scope: CPU feature extraction + inference; excludes audio driver, network, rendering and application startup
timing_note: Throughput is offline capacity, not the live update rate. The 10 ms smoothing time is an EMA time constant, not a fixed deadline.
memory_scope: This CLI process after imports and inference; GUI/driver/receiver memory excluded
measurement_load: GPU training active, audio preparation completed; CPU cost probe, not accuracy
candidate_weights: Function-preserving or warm-start cost probe; do not interpret compressed size as final trained size
